baseline.guard: current reconciliation receipt exact input/task/target; REVIEW additionally TaskFresh
baseline.effects: Append evidence/reason; target other than REVIEW transitively invalidates dependents.

complete_frozen_contract.evidence_rule: This is a planned responsibility mapping. The receiver must attach observed test/review evidence or an explicit supported N/A rationale. Broad source overlap is not row-specific coverage proof.

accepted_intentional_change.meaning: Former destructive dependent invalidation is intentionally replaced by preserved independent progress/check history and derived readiness. The frozen intake is unchanged; this proof does not claim the old destructive effect remains.

mapping.clause: from any task; optional current receipt path
mapping.runtime: Authentic reconciliation receipt created by real native evidence-context and capture-observation/load owners; all three admitted target outputs exercised. Receipt-specific branch has no predicate on prior progress state; tests start from REVIEW, no exhaustive state cross-product is claimed.
subject/input/definition/target failures; capture-input-binding and capture-task-binding refuse at the earlier production capture owner. No hand-forged admitted receipt bypasses that check.
REVIEW succeeds with current verification/spec-review receipts, rejects missing or stale evidence with current reconciliation observation.
All three outputs, exact selected-only receipt append and requested reason; unrelated receipt never attached. Exact replay appends nothing and stale CAS changes no retained bytes.

mapping.clause: candidate dependent effect under accepted D-PROGRESS=B
mapping.runtime: Both dependent recorded progress records, complete task-check history and normative requirements remain equal; non-REVIEW selects ProgressVersion.

Real current native owner refuses foreign/stale/mismatched claims; snapshots of all retained .codearbiter files are identical on refusals. This is representative finite boundary coverage, not a claim every malformed serialization or OS failure was executed.

qualification_limit: Native engine semantics using synthetic host observations. Actual user approval, installed-host policy, physical UI, whole NT09/NT11/NT12 tasks, six-platform and program/publication remain separate.
